newsitem.title: UK: UK Smiths Industries up ahead of results.
newsitem.headline: UK Smiths Industries up ahead of results.

text.p: Shares in Smiths Industries jumped on Monday as investors prepared for a set of strong financial results from the company, due for release on Wednesday.
By 0816 GMT, the shares were up 12-1/2p to 789p.
"The figures are out Wednesday and there was speculation in the weekend press saying how good (the profits) will be," said one market maker.

Analysts were forecasting pre-tax profits of 159 million to 165 million stg for the year to end July, up from 138 million stg last time. The dividend is expected to be raised by 11 percent to 16p on earnings per share up 16 percent at 36.4p.
Smith Industries shares reached a record peak at 810p on October 1, and have slipped since until today's rebound.
